evidence.source_reference: sonnet-testing 2026-08-12: probe v1 (echo stand-in) and probe v5 (toy command) both returned vacuous controls; only the exact 672-char case command exposed the paren-delimitation denial

expected_behavior: A probe or control exercises the exact artifact under test (the case's real command, real prompt, real session shape including --agent); a stand-in is only valid with evidence it shares the discriminating property
observation: Two throwaway probes in one session generalized from stand-in commands (echo for an interpreter; a 40-char one-paren command for a 672-char four-paren command). Both times every control arm passed and the probe proved nothing, costing a wasted paid cycle each, because the stand-in sat in a different approval/risk class than the artifact under test.
